classification_rule: RUNTIME_PROVEN always applies only to the stated accepted captures, never all bosses or combinations. SOURCE_PROVEN describes the reviewed installed/production boundaries with runtime subsets noted separately. Historical document-only runtime summaries are INDIRECTLY_SUPPORTED. No experiment is run for this consolidation.

invariants.scope: Current production classification and eligible native family wrappers.
invariants.evidence: GearStageClasses explicitly classifies Royal Bow; unclassified gear resolves no Stage. NativeScalableDamage selects exact native family holders, and wrappers modify only their existing eligible operation. No global attack attribute multiplier.
invariants.runtime_limit: Accepted native/plain controls support isolation, but there is no exhaustive runtime matrix of every external weapon.

invariants.scope: Accepted P5, Elemental E2, Soul S3/S3F, Energy ES3 and Severance sustained captures.
invariants.evidence: P5 has 860 physical and 860 legitimate family events, not duplicate physical damage. Soul/Elemental/Energy strict captures reject duplicate identities/calls. Native Severance ceiling enforcement may emit a separate entity-less tensura:severance source; V4 records 1238 attempts/360 applications separately from 1664 physical events. No second physical hit is invented.
invariants.runtime_limit: No exhaustive simultaneous family/equipment/multiplayer matrix. Candidate-C metrics validate that development capture only; they do not approve the architecture.

invariants.scope: Accepted positive, plain, legacy-empty and native-defense controls in the causal family studies.
invariants.evidence: Elemental's 15 empty-dispatch controls create no native source; natural ticking restores legitimate delivery. Plain Soul controls create none; native gates explain source/event differences. Energy absent callbacks create no drain or phantom cooldown. Incoming/source/accepted-event counts are separately recorded.
invariants.runtime_limit: Only the accepted controls are directly proven; no claim that all possible native vetoes were exercised.

invariants.scope: Approved production wrappers, distinct from documented development fixture setup and native storage writers.
invariants.evidence: AdditionalDamage, Soul and Energy wrappers call the original native operation once with a scoped argument; Slotting changes the native projectile coefficient. Native wound owns its storage/heal ceiling. Soul/Energy runtime setter reconciliation finds no unexplained changes. Diagnostic HP placement in P2 is setup for A/B/C states, not production subtraction.
invariants.runtime_limit: Runtime accounting is scoped to recorded actors/cases; no general assertion about every third-party resource writer.

invariants.rule: Stage creates no effect when the native mechanic is absent
invariants.scope: Soul/Energy plain controls, Elemental legacy dispatch and native-denial controls; production source guard also reviewed.
invariants.evidence: Stage scales only an already reached native family boundary. Plain S0/S7 Soul remains absent; plain native Energy has no drain. Elemental absent dispatch is not repaired by Stage. Source classification leaves unrecognized holders unchanged; native Severance level<=0 gives no adjustment.
invariants.runtime_limit: Not a runtime test of every absent enchantment/family/Stage combination.

invariants.scope: 77 decisive Energy rows, including native controls and both physical-prerequisite comparisons.
invariants.evidence: Each eligible native callback has one apply/drain operation with reconciled MP/AP/cooldown writes. ES3a has 22 drains; the historical differential 35. Rejections have none. Strict negative suites reject duplicate/forged operations.
invariants.runtime_limit: The preserved initial double-release research diagnostic is invalid acceptance evidence and excluded; corrected production-native capture has no duplicate.

invariants.scope: Accepted S2 native controls plus S3/S3F Royal comparison.
invariants.evidence: 20 Royal callbacks produce 16 native sources and 12 accepted spiritual continuations; each accepted continuation has one native SHP subtraction. Recoveries are separately recorded native operations, not extra Soul hits.
invariants.runtime_limit: Single-shot selected profiles only; all multiplayer/combination interactions remain untested.

invariants.scope: 90 accepted single-core cases, five elements, including same-UUID rescue.
invariants.evidence: 90 distinct projectiles, zero duplicate family events. 75 sources, 71 incoming, 46 applied reflect actual native dispatch and defenses. Intercepted one-core release makes no Royal Arrow. Later on_fire and native utility are kept separate.
invariants.runtime_limit: Not multi-core, area-overlap, all-target or multiplayer acceptance.

invariants.rule: No persistent TNO Gear EP progression
invariants.evidence: Stage reads Tensura EP from the gear component; no separate TNO XP/EP accumulation or arrow progression. Elemental persistent projectile data holds only an attack-time Stage snapshot for delayed collision, not independent progression. The first-engraving item marker is one-time conversion metadata, not XP.
invariants.runtime_limit: No new save/reload or human-client progression test was performed for this review.

invariants.scope: Production native source wrappers and approved exact Magic/Holy L2 negotiation, supported by accepted full-stack captures.
invariants.evidence: Q/RD/RA are the authorized two-family adjustment; Tank, native health/SHP and Regenerate are excluded, Dementor/Adaptive remain harmful. Other families receive no such recovery. Soul's spiritual channel naturally avoids the ordinary HP pipeline; Energy follows native hurt admission. Failed adapter registration/read leaves ordinary Phase 6 intact.
invariants.runtime_limit: Selected profiles are runtime-supported. No complete trait-combination matrix; bridge failure modes are source/focused-test coverage, not all runtime exercised.

invariants.scope: Installed native callbacks, source identities and scoped matching Resistance negotiation.
invariants.evidence: Existing matching Resistance recovery intentionally uses native source metadata to avoid applying that same Resistance twice; it is not a claim of zero bypass metadata in every family. Native Soul tags are preserved. Direct spiritual gates, elemental eligibility, Energy immunity/caps and wound protection remain authoritative; no fallback source or eligible-hit fabrication.
invariants.runtime_limit: Selected native gates are observed; source-only and unselected branches are explicitly not upgraded to runtime PASS.

invariants.scope: All matching families under native active/not-natively-disabled conditions; family-specific runtime support varies.
invariants.evidence: MatchingResistanceRecovery declines recovery when matching Nullification is active; Magic/Holy context also refuses admission. Soul calls native directSpiritualHurt which retains its Nullification return. Elemental directly proves 25 matching denials across all five elements including S7. Energy proves Luminous physical prerequisite Nullification denial.
invariants.runtime_limit: Magic/Holy matching and Soul Spiritual Nullification were not active in their selected final runtime profiles; those family claims remain source/focused-test level.

invariants.rule: No APO damage folded into Stage family scaling
invariants.scope: Eligible family amount isolation and Severance's additive native +3 delta.
invariants.evidence: Source scales the native family callback/coefficient/percentage, not the full physical hit. Severance adds only the difference between staged and native +3 to the already modified physical base. Original 6F Ancient Royal acceptance supports integration indirectly; its raw captures were not retained.
invariants.runtime_limit: P5 uses APO=NONE. The original 6F five-release/ten-projectile APO case is document-supported, not independently raw-verified here. No complete affix matrix.

invariants.rule: Base Royal Arrow remains outside family-specific scaling where required
invariants.scope: All six approved family integration boundaries with native prerequisite behavior retained.
invariants.evidence: Magic/Holy/Soul scale native family arguments; Soul may derive its native argument from the physical attempt without modifying that physical amount. Energy scales a drain percentage. Slotting intercepts into a projectile with no Royal Arrow. Severance modifies only its own +3 contribution within the combined physical hit, preserving native rounding.
invariants.runtime_limit: P5 and native/plain controls support the source conclusion within their fixtures; all external equipment combinations are not runtime proven.

coverage_limits.reason: Acceptance and counts retained in production documentation; temporary raw matrix/harness not in Git. Source isolation remains directly reviewable.

coverage_limits.scope: All-six-family simultaneous combinations, multi-core Elemental, every affix and every boss/defense
coverage_limits.reason: Independent native-path studies and a bounded Magic/Holy/Severance rotation do not constitute this matrix.

coverage_limits.scope: Human-client multiplayer combat and progression acceptance
coverage_limits.reason: Accepted causal fixtures use server-side FakePlayers; no multiplayer claim follows.
The completed studies establish causal native delivery/admission/accounting. They do not measure full sustained boss strength.

coverage_limits.reason: Native/production guards retained; selected final profiles do not carry those active defenses. Elemental matching Nullification is separately runtime proven.
